feeds.title: Rolfing Iowa Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Frank Epstein, my job is to facilitate physical change that alleviates pain while allowing your body freer movements and better alignment. At Rolfing Iowa, my goal is to bring your body into a new alignment that improves physical abilities and establishes better balance and greater flexibility. By releasing the deep soft tissue of the body, you will feel relief from chronic tension and back pain. You'll enjoy increased energy, ease of movement, improved posture and a sense of emotional wellbeing.

feeds.title: Williams Rolfing Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Williams rolfing. There is good news for everyone who wants more from their body. Our persistent complaints about comfort, flexibility, and performance can usually be addressed by changing the structural balance of our bodies. The goal of treatment is to create a well-organized body that is free of pain and problematic health issues. The result is the emergence of a youthful and vital body that provides all the enjoyments of good health.

feeds.title: Sharon Sklar Rolfing Blog
feeds.description: Sharon Sklar has been Rolfing in Central Connecticut since 1981 and is so blessed to love her work. Using a combination of bodywork and movement education, Rolfing manipulates the body's connective tissue to rebalance the major segments of the body and brings relief from chronic pain due to stress, injuries, trauma and surgery. This allows for more natural, free movement. Results can be dramatic.

feeds.title: Aligned Bodies Blog
feeds.description: Blog about Rolfing structural integration, movement and anatomy. I'm Alain, a Certified Rolfer practicing Rolfing in London. I offer Rolfing Structural Integration to people of all ages and backgrounds. These are available to book in venues in Central and West London including Mayfair and Chiswick. Align and Balance Your Body with Rolfing Structural Integration

feeds.title: Horan Rolfing Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Christopher Horan. I've been a Rolfer since 2009. As a Certified Rolfer® and a Certified Functional Nutrition Counselor, my holistic approach to mind-body health aims to support your path to a healthier life. I invite you to learn more about my approach to holistic health and to take advantage of the combination of structural and internal health modalities I can offer you at Horan Holistic Health.

feeds.title: London Rolfing Blog
feeds.description: Naomi Wynter-Vincent is the founder of London Rolfing, working in both London and Luton. She is one of only a few UK practitioners to be certified both as an Advanced Rolfer and a Rolf Movement practitioner in addition to her original Rolfing certification. Naomi completed her practitioner training in London and took her advanced training and the Rolf Movement Practitioner qualifications in Munich.

feeds.title: Rolfing & Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Chelsey is a Certified Rolfer, Thai Bodyworker and Advanced Yoga Instructor with over 1,200 hours of interdisciplinary training. She aims to recognize and treat the deep interconnected roots of each client's ailments. Chelsey's work has produced profound and lasting improvements in mobility, pain, posture, energy, and body awareness. Chelsey completed her Rolfing® training with renowned faculty at the Dr. Ida Rolf Institute of Structural Integration in 2017 and has been practicing full-time in NYC ever since.

feeds.title: Freedom Rolfing Blog
feeds.description: My name is Mike Knapp, Founder of Freedom Rolfing. I work with people throughout Fort Bragg-Fayetteville & Sanford areas and also with people online who are dealing with injuries and pain. I have over 15 years of bodywork experience and have attended workshops throughout the US and in Europe to gain knowledge from differing points of view.

feeds.title: Frome Physical Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Caring For Your Health, is a blog that explores holistic health. Posts on acupuncture, Rolfing, physical therapy, and air quality. We are Frome Physical Therapy, a holistic wellness center with offices in Asbury Park and Montclair, NJ. What makes us unique is our strong grounding in western medicine and our deep commitment to holistic health.
